categories.name: Pause on app minimize/world-away; resume only media paused by Colosseum
categories.recommendation: Keep existing Colosseum implementation; adapt explicit identity/reason and capability reporting into existing owners.
categories.owner: SessionStore -> retained FeriaSessionDeck entry -> FeriaQtWebEngine presentation command -> volatile document-owned FeriaPlayback ledger
implemented: Aggregate activitySuspended is derived from world/app display state and main/auxiliary window minimized state, not ordinary inactive-tab visibility.
Per-element WeakMap captures media object, ownerDocument, currentSrc/src, original play/pause methods; owned flag is set only when Colosseum's pause leaves playing element paused.
Navigation epoch and presentation serial fence stale presentation commands; source/document/connected/ended checks gate resume; explicit page pause/play and input revoke ownership.
Optional freeze observes engine recommendedState, recentlyAudible, close blocker and physical pendingJavaScript count.
gaps: Reason is an aggregate suspended boolean, not a typed per-reason ledger; canonical SessionStore identity is not explicitly carried in presentation script.
Same-origin/open shadow DOM traversal is bounded; cross-origin frames, later-added frame/shadow roots, closed shadow roots and non-HTML-media players are not universal control.
applyPresentationActivity does not consume a script result; play promise rejection is swallowed, so pause/resume success is not acknowledged to shared owner.
Explicit freeze blocker binds closeController.busy, not every permission/licence/request lifetime.
Page-world element monkeypatching/provider-held native methods limit guarantees; exact same-origin frame removal/replacement must be qualified, not presumed broken.

categories.name: Download request ownership and admission
categories.recommendation: Keep profile listener, request identity capture and metadata grants; resolve product auto-save/destination policy and extend request provenance without a second store.
categories.owner: FeriaSessionDeck profile-scoped FeriaBrowserDownloads; native engine owns request mechanism; FeriaAccountStore owns metadata authorization
implemented: Exactly one receiver per regular/private shared profile in the production deck; source view session/visit captured during signal, never read from later selection.
Synchronous receive creates a per-request entry, uses Qt's default/collision-resolved destination unchanged and immediately accepts; inactive/entry-creation failure cancels.

Private/profile/store identities are captured. The QML boundary-double fallback accepts a null-view/unowned request and omits history, but real Qt originless/stale-view getter handling is unqualified.
Native grant is UUID, current non-private visit checked at minting, profile path and provider captured; history-write permission is separate from transfer admission.
gaps: No inspected product ask/download-directory preference or independent user-consent record; default auto-save is current behavior, not by itself a demonstrated defect.
Originating frame/origin, canonical account/space/page/document identity and native request ID are not captured by receiver; request.url is transfer URL, not source-frame identity.
Grant binds profile/provider but does not bind transfer ID, source URL, destination/file identity; trusted descriptor path is accepted.
Multiple transfers are modeled but real multi-space/multi-window same-profile concurrency/one-listener proof remains a fixture gap.

Pinned Qt Quick view() unconditionally dereferences adapterClient although its profile can set adapterClient=nullptr. The QML null-view fallback cannot prove real native originless safety; no post-close re-read should be introduced.

categories.name: Download progress/pause/resume/cancel/open
categories.recommendation: Keep native request state/actions; adapt typed capability/action results and verified file Open in the existing owner.
categories.owner: Live native WebEngineDownloadRequest projected by FeriaBrowserDownloads.downloadEntry
implemented: receivedBytes/totalBytes/state/isPaused/isFinished are native-bound; unknown/zero total is indeterminate while active.
Completed is exact DownloadCompleted; cancelled is separately labeled and releases grant.
Pause/resume/cancel route to native request; interruption retains metadata grant and is exposed as Resume.
Native path/name is used; renderer-supplied text is not interpolated into script.
gaps: All interrupted entries expose Resume without a separate resumability/reason capability or native action outcome.
Open/Open folder calls Qt.openUrlExternally with path strings; no file existence, current account authorization or completed-file identity validation at action time.
History Open ignores persisted state and reload validation; metadata strings are not proof a file exists.
Live entries are not pruned until retirement; cancelled/completed rows may accumulate.
No inspected real-native interruption, zero-byte/unknown-length, cancel/completion-race, missing/replaced-file or safe Open fixture.

Source-inferred stale-final-byte-count risk: pinned Qt emits Completed stateChanged before updating received/total bytes, while QML immediately commits once and recorded prevents refresh at later isFinishedChanged.

categories.name: Download persistence and private cleanup
categories.recommendation: Keep FeriaAccountStore history/grants and profile retirement; preserve private profile through valid dependent transfers and distinguish metadata rejection from write failure.
categories.owner: FeriaAccountStore persistent browserDownloadHistory; FeriaBrowserDownloads transient entries; FeriaSessionDeck profile lifecycle
implemented: Accepted ordinary transfer grant survives endSessionVisit/source navigation, while new grants require live visit.
Private downloads cannot mint ordinary grants; QML private projection omits ordinary history; ordinary rows capped at 100 on commit.
Successful commit consumes grant once, reentrant commit is blocked, failed atomic QSaveFile write preserves grant/in-memory state for retry.
Account path switch clears all visits/grants; production account binding then triggers profile quiescence and cancellation.
No native transfer restart/resume data is serialized; clearing history affects metadata, not saved files.
gaps: Last private-space retirement waits on views only then cancels private downloads; does not preserve last dependent valid transfer as proposed contract requires.
Profile teardown calls cancel then destroys entries/profiles without explicit terminal transfer-drain acknowledgement; native cancellation lifetime requires engine qualification.
Any failed recordBrowserDownload is treated as retryable, including invalidated grant or permanently inadmissible source URL.
Reload imports browserDownloadHistory without path/state revalidation; active transfer state and current filesystem availability are not reconciled.
One boundary test's old-account token-clear assertion disagrees with retry-retaining current QML; no tests executed.

Persisted completed history can retain preterminal byte counts when the final native update changes state and bytes together; existing double sets bytes before state and does not cover the native order.

categories.name: Save page/link/image/media through native download pipeline
categories.recommendation: Use supported public engine APIs through existing profile download owner; retain separate Print/PDF semantics. Default engine save exposure is donor-dependent/unqualified here.
categories.owner: Current FeriaPageTools handles Find/zoom; FeriaBrowserRequests owns Print/PDF; no custom typed Save context owner found
implemented: Print/PDF invokes public browser.printToPdf after FileDialog destination and generation/browser/active checks.
Ordinary native attachment download reaches existing profile pipeline and has a real-engine local fixture.
Retained view has no custom onContextMenuRequested interception in inspected files, so native default-menu capability must be assessed from engine source rather than assumed absent.
gaps: No explicit savePage/saveLink/saveImage/saveMedia action, context capability snapshot, source frame/native context token or shared Save operation found in inspected production entry path.
Print/PDF is a separate native API with path completion signal, not FeriaBrowserDownloads transfer/history pipeline.
No inspected page-save format, frame/context-staleness, unsafe filename, blob/media or destination-cancel integration fixture.
No app-controlled WebView2 download/Save adapter found in the bounded host/wrapper; do not infer parity from engine defaults.

negative_controls_proposed: Break owned-media flag and verify manually paused element wrongly resumes; control must fail.
Replace source-space with active selection on request completion; concurrent A/B fixture must fail.
Consume grant before failing metadata disk write; same-grant retry fixture must fail.
Retain account A grant on setStoragePath(B); stale completion fixture must fail.
Allow last private-view teardown before private transfer finishes; transfer-survival fixture must fail.
Open replaced/missing/arbitrary descriptor path; file-identity and authorization fixture must reject.
Retain context-save ticket across navigation/frame destruction; stale Save fixture must reject.
Drive a real Qt originless download path; prove request.view handling is safe or report blocked. A mock view:null is insufficient; do not manufacture an origin from active selection.

Deliver one final native download update containing Completed plus changed receivedBytes/totalBytes, in Qt state-before-bytes-before-isFinished order; assert one history row with exact final byte counts and one consumed grant. A first-stateChanged snapshot-only implementation must fail.

canonical_file_owner_check.bounded_search: Followed current Feria direct Qt.openUrlExternally calls; inspected pinned repository filename inventory for generic file/download owners, native/main.cpp wiring, and only relevant owner APIs/definitions. Did not audit medium-specific network/decode pipelines.
canonical_file_owner_check.conclusion: No inspected owner provides a general Feria-account/profile/private/transfer-authorized arbitrary-file Open/reveal boundary. Extend existing FeriaAccountStore and FeriaBrowserPolicy; do not create a parallel registry or migrate browser transfers to independent media download engines.

reuse_candidates.reuse: Explicit in-app opening of supported media after Feria admission may reuse existence/family/backend validation and canonical Vault identity, rather than inventing media identity.
reuse_candidates.limits: Not arbitrary-file external Open; no Feria grant/profile binding; routeMap/openSingle can write Vault identity/recent state.

reuse_candidates.reuse: Existing cross-world presentation patterns, only if separately needed.
reuse_candidates.limits: Read model delegates to media backbones; no Feria integration, files, network or general Open/reveal authority.
Theatre-specific transfer and reveal path; not browser-profile aware.

reuse_candidates.reuse: None required for Feria transfer-bound authorization.
reuse_candidates.limits: Portable desired-content intent, not live transfer/file capability; fields omit paths and URLs.
Deletion utility / media-container projection respectively; neither supplies Feria admission.
